reels.hook: Waterproof PP shuttering sheet se barish aur keechad mein bhi site ka kaam chalu rakhiye.
Slab dhalai ke baad jaldi de-shuttering karne se concrete kamzor ho sakta hai. Sahi time par hi shuttering kholein.
Slab dhalai mein cover block miss mat kijiye! Sahi cover aur PP shuttering sheet se milti hai majboot finish.
Kya barish mein dhalai karni chahiye?
Site pe chai thandi ho jaye par ply ka kharcha khatam nahi hota! Upgrade kijiye PP shuttering sheet par.
Site par chahe kitni bhi jaldi ho, garam chai ke bina kaam shuru nahi hota!
Myth: PP sheet mein kil nahi lagti

images.hook: Site pe lagao, kaam shuru. Column aur slab dono.
Sariya cage taiyaar, phir PP panel se column band.
